Welcome to the SBDI part of the [first in-person Swedish Metabarcoding Network (SMN) meeting & hands-on workshop](https://metabarcoding.se/meeting-2026/){target="_blank"}, Uppsala, 8–9 December 2026! This tutorial demonstrates how eDNA/metabarcoding data can be accessed, processed and analysed within the [Swedish Biodiversity Data Infrastructure (SBDI)](https://biodiversitydata.se/){target="_blank"}: from downloading data from the ASV portal to exploring biodiversity patterns in R, with data kept in long format from start to end.

You choose one of two case studies:

- **Insects:** COI metabarcoding data of arthropods across Swedish habitat types, from the [Insect Biome Atlas](https://www.insectbiomeatlas.org/){target="_blank"}
- **Marine plankton:** 16S metabarcoding data of bacterioplankton along the salinity gradient of the Baltic Sea

## Agenda

Wednesday 9 December 2026, 09:00–12:00 (hands-on workshops)<br>
Evolutionsbiologiskt centrum (EBC), Norbyvägen 14, Uppsala

- **Introduction:** SBDI's eDNA tools and workflows ([slides](slides-intro.pdf){target="_blank"})
- **[Hands-on tutorial](tutorial.qmd):** Analyse ASV portal data with R, for insects or marine plankton

Times may still change. See the [meeting page](https://metabarcoding.se/meeting-2026/){target="_blank"} for the full programme.
